notes.title: Newest Team Ladybug Title: New Blade Chimera Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Team Ladybug and Metroidvania fans,

There's only a month left until the release of Blade Chimera, Team Ladybug's very first original Metroidvania, on January 16, 2025!

In response to feedback from Team Ladybug fans, Blade Chimera has a larger map and more side quests than any previous title, making it an even deeper and longlasting experience for players.

We've released a new and updated demo for Blade Chimera, so please check it out to get a feel for the game yourself!
Back in June, we made a demo for Steam Next Fest, and in the past half year that demo has been further improved and expanded on to make this new demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/c12eb0a55ee8ce4f28f9fc6b465f698e777e08fe.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Stage 2: Phoenix Gardens is now playable
[*]Added a new ability to Lux, the Demon Sword: When you’re separated from the Demon Sword, power is charged in the blade. When it returns to you, it creates a shockwave that deals damage along its path
[*]Added a new collectable item: Puzzle Pieces
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/83f454527ba0ef8b530cf4cad2d914fb511c9e4a.gif[/img]
We hope you like the new demo! Please wishlist the game and look forward to launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/c68c4aac178c96060a8d9ab74ccd83736313eec6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Record of Lodoss War ~Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth~ Full Release!
notes.content:
Dear fans,

The full release is finally ready!
The mysteries of the labyrinth into which Deedlit has wandered will be unravelled, and the heart-wrenching climax leads directly into the latest installment in the series, Record of Lodoss War: Diadem of the Covenant...!

Stages 5 and 6 have been added to the full release, completing this six-stage 2D action-exploration title. With a slew of tough enemies and hardcore bosses even more powerful than those in the preceding stages, you won’t be able to put the controller down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/d2a96ec83ae1b0cf7aae96a359987a8911a462b8.gif[/img]

One boss of Stage 5 is the Emperor Beld of Marmo, also known as the “Dark Emperor”.
Infamous as one of the best swordsmen in Lodoss, he’ll use his amazing powers and prowess with his blade to stop Deedlit in her tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/fa6f2d80e9c65949a99977bbf631d99e8506679e.gif[/img]

Featuring all-new weapons and magic, like the magical blade of Lodoss known as “Soul Crusher”.
Chock full of stage gimmicks requiring spirit powers and arrows to clear, your bow & arrow skills will truly be put to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/4872d3b55f30167ae34fef4e58e53e6baba3bcda.gif[/img]

Unexpectedly forced to face off against previously appearing friends such as Etoh, Slayn, Ghim, and Woodchuck, Deedlit will finally find out the truth behind their words of warning and encouragement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/1feb5cdd7c4e81358dba662fccf9e66e04fe2fda.gif[/img]

Also, in response to the overwhelming feedback received from players around the world during Early Access, the following contents have been included in this update.
Thank you for all your support and requests.

[list]
[*] Easier map location checking
[*] Fixed explosions after unpausing
[*] Cubes released by enemies are now opaque, improving visibility
[*] Stun conditions updated
[*] Rooms containing bosses can now be checked from outside
[*] Difficulty levels of existing stages have been adjusted to better fit the entire game
[*] Player-character afterimage can now be turned off in settings
[/list]

A large number of bug fixes, fine tuning, and other adjustments are also included.

We have a message to share from Team Ladybug.
[quote=author] Thank you so much for playing our games.
Thank you also for all your feedback and comments as well.
We strive to provide the sort of game balance that will allow any
level of player to feel that they had fun upon completing a game.
In order to realize this goal for this title,
we listened to and implemented as much player feedback as possible.
With this full release, the story finally comes to a close.
We truly hope that this game can help everyone to think positively about the future.
We hope you enjoy playing it.[/quote] 

[h2]Original soundtrack featuring all 22 tracks also released![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/b7d3dcdc76d5c262d3b99f6e347a61bff8d71c64.png[/img]

In commemoration of the game’s long-awaited full release, we have also released the Record of Lodoss War ~Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth~ full original soundtrack,
containing all 22 tracks, to Steam. This soundtrack was created and produced by PEPOSOFT, also known for the Touhou Luna Nights soundtrack as well as their work on this game itself.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567820/
We’ve also prepared a special bundle including both the full game and the soundtrack, available for 10% off the combined MSRP. Be sure to pick up this bundle for maximum content and savings!

Record of Lodoss War ~Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth~ Bundle
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20482/

We also have a "Team Ladybug Bundle" set - which also includes Touhou Luna Nights - available for even further savings. Don't miss this chance to pick up some of Team Ladybug's most beloved Matroidvania works!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20245/Team_Ladybug_Bundle/

We hope you all love Record of Lodoss War ~Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth~ as much as we do.

notes.title: Content update adding stage 3+4 now live! Update celebration sale now on too!
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

The major content update which adds Stage 3 "The Fortress of Mist" and Stage 4 "The Dark Capital" is now live. The new stages feature an old overgrown fortress and desert like environments. Both areas feature new gimmicks based around the usage of your bow and the update also adds the bow training area where you can brush up your archery skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/1bc3cce0acf259d46b0d72ebb32d6f4786c7263d.gif[/img]

The update also brings new throwing weapons for Deedlit to use such as the Boomerang and Shuriken. Confuse your enemies with the new Invisibility ability or traverse submerged areas with Water Breathing. We hope you enjoy exploring the expanded labyrinth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/ba272efb4c819e6c5e18366748b8fd61bb4fcf4d.gif[/img]

Karla, the Demon God and black dragon Narse will appear as bosses. Parn, beloved of Deedlit and protagonist of the original novels, will also make an appearance. With his appearance, the story begins to pick up the pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/35fd3ade451de321d719e49f0df485157e472a5c.gif[/img]

There are also plenty of adjustments to reflect user feedback.

[h3]■ Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added multiple language support to the pause and key config menus.
[*] You can now change sound and other settings from the pause menu.
[*] Gamepad rumble support added.
[*] Added game manual which can be checked in game at any time.
[*] Text font resolution has been doubled, making it easier to read.
[*] From stage 3 enemies have been added that can use attacks which inflict stun, poison and burn status effects.
[*] Bow aiming now slows down while holding the backdash button for more precise aiming.
[*] Changed the color of Magic.
[*] Minor motion adjustments.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/3d35bd68257a6e19bd2501cf4baefe79585ec694.gif[/img]

[b]This title is planned to come out of early access into full release with the next major content update this Spring along with a price revision. To celebrate the the new stage 3+4 update it is currently 20% off, so please take this opportunity to get in on the early access.[/b]

[h2]Touhou Luna Nights has received its Cirno update too![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/dc7d23b265473a9546d7ddc450534ae200636950.gif[/img]
Touhou Luna Nights, the critically acclaimed Touhou spin-off 2D exploration title from Team Ladybug, has also received an update adding the boss Cirno! Touhou Luna Nights is also currently 33% off to celebrate the release of the update.

[*] A new Game Manual, which can be checked in game at any time.

notes.title: The long-awaited stage 2 update is here! Plus, results from the Fan Art Contest!
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

The stage 2 update for Record of Lodoss War: Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth has gone live today! The update introduces new magic and bow mechanics among other things! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/7a2bf9d34cefaeb33f68fc7d4671df8b83552715.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/816b7580dd9e26929d80d3c68d24016da3efcbce.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/d5f18e9ecfb93d0547f6ccf894cd2e0bab2d12c1.gif[/img]

Also Woodchuck will make an appearance and invite you to gamble!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/dcd4413de5a790a66e76d0fe360cedf536c824cd.png[/img]

Team Ladybug is extremely grateful for all of your passionate comments regarding the game since it released into early access.

Here is a message from them:

Thanks you for all the comments and requests!
In this stage 2 update we have made the following adjustments as per some of your requests!

[list]
[*] Moved initial cursor position to the weapon list when paused.
[*] Pause menu can now be exited with the cancel button.
[*] Altered back dash animation.
[*] Added weapon attack animations.
[*] Can now stop in place when hovering by pressing the back dash button.
    From this position you will be able to aim your bow or attack above or below with your weapon.
[*] When aiming with the bow you can now change the direction you're facing by back dashing.
[*] Toned down afterimage effects.
[*] Adjusted graphics slightly to make it easier to find hidden areas.
[*] Locked door colors now appear on the map.
[*] Magic attack power balance adjustment.
[*] Added Spirit power up items.
[/list]

Apart from these adjustments that you requested,
we are planning to address more of your requests in the next update or subsequent updates after that.
There are also others that do not line up with our vision of the game so we ask for your understanding there.
We hope you enjoy this update for Record of Lodoss war: Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth!

――
We look forward to your continued support for the title!

[h2]Fan Art Contest Results Announcement[/h2]

In other news the results from the Fan Art Contest held in April are out. Thank you for your submissions and we were mightily impressed by the quality of your art! 
Results below:

[h3]The Top Prize goes to...[/h3]

[h3][b]Chizuru Kai [/b]([url=https://twitter.com/forest_f3]@forest_f3[/url]）!![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/ea4bafd5b0ff52f6a3b7c48fc59deef888af903b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Runners Up are:[/h3]

[h3][b]Mech Zilla[/b]（[url=https://twitter.com/mech_zilla]@mech_zilla[/url]）[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/83a9d5951a2f52d94ee7e9b99fd215ad898cbdcb.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]3Hard[/b]（[url=https://twitter.com/3HardKen]@3HardKen[/url]）[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/c698cc1f5dfd78988f9c5600de94254b9adba614.jpg[/img]

Congratulations!
You will be contacted through DM by staff regarding your prize.
The winning artwork from [url=https://twitter.com/forest_f3]@forest_f3[/url] is being used as official banner artwork from this update.
We hope you enjoy this piece as much as we did!

Team ladybug are right back to work on the next update,
so please keep your comments and requests coming!
